title: Pure Ancient Warriors
summary: Ancient Warriors cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Ancient Warriors are Beast-Warriors that play best when the opponent controls more monsters. Their Saga Continuous Spells/Traps get sent from the field on purpose to fuel the monsters. Ancient Warriors - Masterful Sun Mou searches another Ancient Warriors monster, and Ancient Warriors Saga - Three Visits searches one each time you summon. Graceful Zhou Gong trades a Continuous card for a Saga from the Deck and negates a monster. Ingenious Zhuge Kong summons itself when searched and negates Spells/Traps. The 2022 cards lead. Ancient Warriors - Savage Don Ying searches a big Ancient Warriors or a Saga and taxes every opposing activation 400 LP. Ancient Warriors Saga - Deception and Betrayal summons one from the hand and can steal a monster by changing its Attribute.
